card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words in news text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on ordinary words in the middle of general news or science sentences, such as 'is', 'a', 'believe' and 'calories'.

modes.label: Verbs and articles before a claim
modes.description: Small words like 'is' or 'a' inside a sentence about a reported survey finding.
